note: "die Anerkennung eines Abschlusses beantragen" — the whole process of getting a foreign degree officially recognised in Germany.

examples.de: Die Anerkennung meines Studiums hat sechs Monate gedauert.
examples.en: Getting my degree recognised took six months.

note: "einen Abschluss anerkennen". Inseparable-feeling but technically separable in some uses; "anerkannt" (Partizip II) is the adjective you'll see most: "ein anerkannter Abschluss".

examples.de: Mein Bachelor wurde als gleichwertig anerkannt.
examples.en: My bachelor's degree was recognised as equivalent.

note: an official statement (often from the Zeugnisbewertungsstelle) on how a foreign school/university certificate compares to a German one.

examples.de: Für die Bewerbung brauche ich eine Zeugnisbewertung.
examples.en: I need a certificate evaluation for the application.

note: "die Gleichwertigkeit feststellen" = to establish equivalence — the core question every recognition process answers.

examples.de: Die Behörde prüft die Gleichwertigkeit des Abschlusses.
examples.en: The authority checks the equivalence of the qualification.

note: the starting point of any Anerkennungsverfahren. Compare "der inländische Abschluss" = a German-earned one.

examples.de: Mein ausländischer Abschluss wurde in drei Schritten anerkannt.
examples.en: My foreign qualification was recognised in three steps.

note: which office handles your recognition depends on your profession — the government's "Anerkennung in Deutschland" portal helps you find it.

examples.de: Für Lehrer ist eine andere Stelle zuständig als für Ärzte.
examples.en: A different office is responsible for teachers than for doctors.

note: extra coursework or an Anpassungslehrgang to close the gap when a foreign qualification is only partly equivalent.

examples.de: Wegen fehlender Praxisstunden brauche ich eine Nachqualifizierung.
examples.en: Because of missing practical hours I need additional qualification.

english: notice listing what's missing for full recognition
note: an official Bescheid (Unit 15's A2 relative — recap) that lists exactly which exams or hours are still required.

examples.de: Im Defizitbescheid stehen zwei fehlende Prüfungen.
examples.en: The deficiency notice lists two missing exams.

note: Germany's is famously tiered — useful to understand if you have or will have children here.

examples.de: Das deutsche Schulsystem unterscheidet sich stark von unserem.
examples.en: The German school system is very different from ours.

note: the same for everyone; after it, children are sorted onto different tracks.

examples.de: Meine Tochter geht seit letztem Jahr in die Grundschule.
examples.en: My daughter has been at primary school since last year.

note: after Grundschule, children split onto tracks that lead to different qualifications and career paths — a system many newcomers find surprising.

examples.de: Die Empfehlung für die weiterführende Schule kommt von der Grundschule.
examples.en: The recommendation for secondary school comes from the primary school.

english: academic-track secondary school leading to the Abitur
note: false friend alert: not a sports gym (that's "das Fitnessstudio"). Leads to the Abitur, the standard university-entrance qualification.

examples.de: Er hat das Gymnasium mit einem guten Abitur abgeschlossen.
examples.en: He finished Gymnasium with a good Abitur.

note: the school part of a duale Ausbildung — trainees attend part-time alongside working at a company.

examples.de: Zweimal pro Woche ist sie in der Berufsschule.
examples.en: Twice a week she's at vocational school.

note: the well-known German model: trainees split their time between a company (practical) and a Berufsschule (theory), and are paid a small salary throughout.

examples.de: Viele Ausländer machen in Deutschland eine duale Ausbildung.
examples.en: Many foreigners do dual vocational training in Germany.

note: "per Fernstudium" — useful if you're working full-time and studying alongside.

examples.de: Sie macht ihren Master berufsbegleitend im Fernstudium.
examples.en: She's doing her master's alongside work, via distance learning.

note: affordable evening courses — languages, computer skills, integration courses — found in almost every German town.

examples.de: Meinen Deutschkurs mache ich an der Volkshochschule.
examples.en: I'm taking my German course at the adult education centre.

note: "sich immatrikulieren" = to enrol. Once done, you get a Studierendenausweis and, in Germany, usually a cheap public-transport ticket.

examples.de: Die Immatrikulation muss vor Semesterbeginn abgeschlossen sein.
examples.en: Enrolment has to be completed before the semester starts.

note: happens automatically after your final exam, or if you formally leave the university.

examples.de: Nach der Abschlussprüfung folgt die Exmatrikulation.
examples.en: De-registration follows the final exam.

note: "die Regelstudienzeit überschreiten" = to take longer than the standard time — common, and usually not a problem.

examples.de: Die Regelstudienzeit für den Bachelor beträgt sechs Semester.
examples.en: The standard study period for the bachelor's is six semesters.

note: each course is worth a set number of Leistungspunkte; a Bachelor typically needs 180.

examples.de: Für diesen Kurs bekommst du fünf Leistungspunkte.
examples.en: You get five credit points for this course.

note: the official rules for your Studiengang — how many attempts you get, deadlines, what counts as a pass.

examples.de: Laut Prüfungsordnung hat man drei Versuche pro Klausur.
examples.en: According to the exam regulations you get three attempts per exam.

note: also just "die Thesis" colloquially. "die Bachelorarbeit" / "die Masterarbeit" name the specific level.

examples.de: Ich schreibe gerade meine Abschlussarbeit.
examples.en: I'm currently writing my thesis.

english: grade-based admission cap for a subject
note: a minimum Abitur grade (or grade equivalent) required when a subject has more applicants than places — common for Medizin, Psychologie.

examples.de: Für Medizin gibt es einen sehr hohen Numerus clausus.
examples.en: There's a very high grade requirement for medicine.

note: the broader term the Numerus clausus is one form of. "zulassungsbeschränkt" (adjective) = "NC-restricted".

examples.de: Dieser Studiengang hat eine Zulassungsbeschränkung.
examples.en: This degree programme has restricted admission.

note: e.g. a telc or Goethe certificate — often required alongside a Zeugnisbewertung for both university admission and professional recognition.

examples.de: Für die Bewerbung brauche ich einen Sprachnachweis auf Niveau B2.
examples.en: For the application I need a language certificate at B2 level.

note: free, often government-funded advice centres that help newcomers navigate the Anerkennungsverfahren step by step.

examples.de: Die Anerkennungsberatung hat mir bei den Formularen geholfen.
examples.en: The recognition counselling service helped me with the forms.

english: formal equivalence procedure (older/Austrian term, still seen)
note: an older term for the recognition procedure, still used especially in Austria; in Germany "Anerkennungsverfahren" is now more common.

examples.de: In manchen Ländern heißt das Verfahren Nostrifizierung.
examples.en: In some countries the procedure is called Nostrifizierung.

note: the 2012 federal law giving everyone the legal right to have a foreign qualification checked, regardless of nationality.

examples.de: Das Anerkennungsgesetz gibt jedem das Recht auf ein Prüfverfahren.
examples.en: The Recognition Act gives everyone the right to a review procedure.
